newsitem.title: USA: Numerex in licensing, OEM deals.
newsitem.headline: Numerex in licensing, OEM deals.

text.p: Numerex Corp said Digital Security Controls Ltd, the largest manufacturer and supplier of alarm equipment in Canada, has signed a license agreement with Numerex unit DCX Systems Inc.
The license agreement grants Digital Security the rights to manufacture and sell line cards that incorporate DCX's proprietary technology into their Sur-Gard brand alarm receivers.
The company also said Europlex Canada has signed a Serial STU OEM agreement with Numerex.

Under this deal, DCX will manufacture the Europlex version of the new Serial STU under the popular Europlex brand name. Europlex is a Canadian manufacturer of alarm panels that are used primarily in the commercial market.
